SEL-E.D₃

Antioxidant and nutritional support with vitamins E, D₃ and selenium.

SEL-E.D₃ brings vitamin E, vitamin D₃ and selenium together in a liquid veterinary formulation. Its nutritional focus connects antioxidant support with the mineral and vitamin requirements of growing and breeding animals.

A closer look at SEL-E.D₃.

The product sits within the nutritional part of the Rigel range. It is relevant to conversations about vitamin and selenium intake, breeding-flock nutrition and the nutritional challenges that can accompany demanding production conditions.

What is in the formulation?

ComponentAvailable formulation detail
Vitamin EIncluded; concentration to be confirmed
Vitamin D₃Included; concentration to be confirmed
SeleniumIncluded; concentration to be confirmed

The product’s care focus.

  • Vitamin E and selenium are the formulation’s antioxidant-focused components.
  • Vitamin D₃ adds a vitamin component associated with calcium and phosphorus nutrition.
  • The presentation is intended for veterinary nutritional support rather than a substitute for a complete feeding programme.

Presentation, route and administration.

The packaging identifies administration through drinking water.

Product-specific directions

A mixing reference of 1 ml per 4 litres of water is shown in the supplied product material. It does not specify a complete species-specific course. Confirm the current product instructions and veterinarian’s plan before preparation.

Build a more useful care conversation.

Prepare these details when discussing SEL-E.D₃ with your veterinary team.

  • Review the existing feed and supplementation programme to account for total vitamin and selenium intake.
  • Identify the species, production stage and reason for supplementation.
  • Confirm the preparation instructions, treatment period and reliable access to water.

Before you take the next step.

What should I request for SEL-E.D₃?+

Ask for the current product specification, the available pack size and directions for your species and market. For a commercial enquiry, include your organisation, country and the quantity or documentation you need.

Does a care category establish suitability for my animal?+

No. The exact formulation, animal’s condition and local product authorisation matter. The treating veterinarian should confirm suitability, administration and any applicable food-production withdrawal requirements.

For veterinary professionals. Product information is an overview; the current locally authorised instructions and prescribing veterinarian determine use. Pack presentation may vary.
